name: UI designer
summary: Specifies the visual design of app and web screens: type scale, spacing, colour, components and states, ready for Figma or code.

changelog.note: First release: role knowledge with 30 sources (WCAG 2.2 and Understanding notes, WCAG 3 draft status, Apple HIG pages with change-log dates including Liquid Glass, Material 3 and Expressive in Compose, the European Accessibility Act on EUR-Lex, ADA and UK pointers), four skills, five prompts, two workflows, training interview and test briefs, and access levels per tool.
